history.summary: Newly-completed (2025) freehold 4BR (1,216sqft) at $1,956 PSF in D14 Geylang/Sims, 820m from Aljunied MRT, priced just below the $1,996 median. A compact 1,216sqft '4BR' is a tightly-stacked layout, and the resale-only trend is sharply negative at -5.2%/yr on 12 txns — a clear warning on a small new-launch boutique.
history.rating_rationale: The negative resale-only appreciation (-5.2%/yr on 12 txns) is the decisive signal: early resales at Gems Ville are coming below developer launch prices, a classic small-boutique new-launch giveback. A 1,216sqft '4BR' is a squeezed layout, Gems Ville is a small development (thin liquidity), and at $1,956 PSF in Geylang-fringe D14 you'd be buying into a falling early-resale market. Freehold doesn't offset a structurally weak liquidity/appreciation profile.
